unsupportedRunOptions.reason: Codex CLI owns its own tool runtime and does not host KOTA MCP servers.
Codex CLI tool policy cannot be constrained through KOTA allowedTools.
Codex CLI tool policy cannot be constrained through KOTA disallowedTools.
Codex CLI tool calls cannot be routed through KOTA's canUseTool gate.
The non-interactive CLI path cannot route approvals through KOTA's queue.
KOTA-managed session persistence is not exposed by this adapter.
KOTA-managed session resume is not exposed by this adapter.
The codex adapter does not accept per-step harnessOptions.
KOTA file checkpointing is not supported by Codex CLI.
Portable effort maps to Codex CLI model_reasoning_effort instead.
